name: sql-assistant
description: SQL Assistant — schema-aware read-only and Change Request SQL generator with an offline self-training NLU, centralized learning, an Admin Query Library, schema CASE/DECODE, cross-device schema synchronization (Pull Schema from GitHub with hidden repository configuration and a Secret Vault pull card), a short cross-device administrator message in the navbar, a manual Sync button in the navbar, a CENTRALIZED Admin Password that is synchronized to every device (with a reset to the default), CENTRAL repository access through a trusted repository access service that holds the GitHub PAT as a GitHub Actions secret (no token on any device), a PUBLISHED copy of the repository data that devices read without any GitHub credential, an optional AI/LLM Model, and (V17.7) an Admin Password authority that confirms the default by evidence and no longer ships a browser-test hook.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['build','build-test','dev-dist','test-dist','release','test-results'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('dist'))for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist'))if(f!=='sql-assistant-data')fs.rmSync('dist/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true})"
